purpose: Use current four locked actuator/contact banks to distinguish voltage headroom from deliberately faster current response.
comparison: All force/controller/acquisition parameters and noise seeds fixed within each pair. Current and physical/rating guards unchanged. Each endpoint plus rigid event limits scored.
interpretation: A voltage change alone improves modeled slew only if clipping is active. A shorter response changes tuning too. Ideal rigid-plate force jumps remain an independent mechanical limit.
